_note: Cost ledger for the pytest tiers. Per tier: the marker expression it selects on, the node ids it collected when this record was written, and the wall time a human measured for it. `tiers` are the Taskfile tasks (their expressions are read back from Taskfile.yml); `witness` are the jobs of .github/workflows/witness.yml (their expression, test path and timeout are read back from the workflow). tests/test_marker_drift.py re-collects every tier (collection only -- no test run) and fails when a tier no longer collects what is recorded here, when a recorded expression stops being the one the task or job runs, and when a `measured` date is older than 30 days; the counts stated in docs/how-to/test-loop.md are checked against this file. Re-record the collected sets after a deliberate tier change with `UPDATE_TIERS=1 uv run --no-sync pytest -q tests/test_marker_drift.py`, then fill wall_seconds/measured by hand from a `time` run of the row's own `command` (each row's note records the conditions it was measured under).

test-fast.expression: not heavy and not slow and not meta
test-fast.command: uv run --no-sync pytest -q -m "not heavy and not slow and not meta"
test-fast.note: time uv run --locked pytest -q <the task's own selection> (835 tests; measured 2026-09-14 at load average ~59 on this 32-CPU box (another session's work was running): the same row measured 31.5s the same day while the box was quiet, before the line platform and the two MCP tools landed). The edit loop's 30s budget is the contract; this number is an observation of the contention

witness-fast.note: time uv run --no-sync pytest -q tests/test_witness_matrix.py -m fast (at the 205-leaf tree of the measurement: 208 tests = 205 leaf renders plus the three leaf-list checks; the render cache emptied first -- the PR job is always cold because a fresh runner has no .cache/renders; 6.4s warm, 39.4s cold, both on a machine carrying unrelated work at load average ~80-106 of 16 cores). The job's timeout in .github/workflows/witness.yml is 30 minutes, so the cold local wall is ~2% of it.
